name: tailed-cursor
title: Tailed Cursor
blurb: Multicolored WebGL-powered cursor trail with spring physics.
description: A WebGL-rendered cursor trail effect using the OGL library. Multiple colored trails follow the cursor with customizable spring physics, fade, and shader wave effects.
use_when: A high-performance interactive background or full-page effect requiring GPU acceleration.
avoid_when: On low-end devices or when you need low resource usage — continuous rendering is GPU-intensive.
a11y: Decorative cursor effect. Uses pointer-events-none; interactions pass through. No keyboard control.
